**Description**

Update @ 25th Apr, 2022,had debug session with Mellanox team, there are auto negotiation capability issues with Arista 7260. 
1.	Arista current version can’t advertising “all” in AN mode.
2.	Arista current version can’t advertising “10G” in AN mode for 100G port.

Based on manual test, the auto negotiation function for Mellanox MSN2700 looks good.
Will set up a new testbed to qualify these testcases, and keep this issue open till it is done.

This testcase doesn't work for all broadcom platforms.
For Mellanox platform, such like 2700, when its neighbor is Arista 7260 (which is broadcom asic), there are testcases
1. test_auto_negotiation_advertised_speeds_all, can pass
2. test_auto_negotiation_fanout_advertises_each_speed, always fail
4. test_auto_negotiation_dut_advertises_each_speed, always fail

linkedPullRequests.author: antonptashnik
linkedPullRequests.body:

### Description of PR
<!--
- Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed.
- Please also include relevant motivation and context. Where should reviewer start? background context?
- List any dependencies that are required for this change.
-->

Summary: parametrized port autoneg tests by used port speeds
Fixes # (issue)
- parametrized port autoneg tests by used port speeds

Port autoneg test check port autoneg feature by setting different speeds in some order on both ends, SONiC DUT and fanout. The speeds are being set in a loop so actual speeds tests use are not visible to a test report. To resolve it the tests were parametrized by interface/speed so now a test report is clear about what interface/speed used for a given test. Example output fragment:
```
test_auto_negotiation_fanout_advertises_each_speed[dut|Ethernet8|40000-ALL_SPEEDS_BY_ALL_LITERAL]
test_auto_negotiation_fanout_advertises_each_speed[dut|Ethernet8|40000-ALL_SPEEDS_BY_SPEEDS_LIST]
test_auto_negotiation_fanout_advertises_each_speed[dut|Ethernet8|100000-ALL_SPEEDS_BY_ALL_LITERAL]
test_force_speed[dut|Ethernet8|40000]
```
- skipped test runs for port speeds limited by a connected SFP
- handled speed change prompt for EOS fanouts
- made test_force_speed to set port FEC explicitly after setting port speed
Port may stay with an FEC unsupported for a given speed since speed/FEC are set separately. To avoid such case a FEC value is set explicitly after speed setup
- fixed https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/5447
